etabli.resume: Solid worktop on a steel frame, designed for daily use.
etabli.description: 45 mm laminated beech top, powder-coated steel frame, two drawers on runners. Delivered assembled or flat-packed.

tabouret.resume: Height-adjustable seat in wood and steel, for standing or seated workstations.
tabouret.description: Oiled beech seat, gas lift, ring footrest. Rated for 130 kg.

vitrine.resume: Counter cabinet glazed on three sides, for displaying objects.
vitrine.description: Solid oak frame, 6 mm toughened glass, optional integrated lighting, removable back panel.

comptoir.resume: Counter in two joinable modules, adaptable to the width of the room.
comptoir.description: Oak front panel, laminate service top, integrated cable run, inner shelf.

livraison.intro: We deliver across the United Kingdom and the European Union.
